description.en: Fades a screen's brightness to a target level and waits for the fade to finish. Passing SCREEN_AB fades both screens together (via CMND_BRIGHT_FADE_ALL); any other screen value fades just that one screen.
Screen buffer to fade (e.g. SCREEN_A, SCREEN_B, or SCREEN_AB for both).
Target brightness level (e.g. -1.0 for black, 0.0 for normal).
Duration of the fade, in frames.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
